inputVariables.name: nameSaid
inputVariables.description: The patient's name exactly as the caller said it, including any spelled letters; empty if not said this turn.

inputVariables.name: dobSaid
inputVariables.description: The patient's date of birth exactly as said, or the correction to it; empty if not said this turn.

inputVariables.name: hintSaid
inputVariables.description: The test name and/or collection date they mentioned, in their words; empty if none.

inputVariables.name: identifierSaid
inputVariables.description: Their answer to an identifier question (collection date, phone, address, state or email), as said; empty otherwise.

inputVariables.name: choiceSaid
inputVariables.description: Their answer when results were offered: yes, or which one they mean, as said; empty otherwise.

inputVariables.name: alsoSaid
inputVariables.description: A second test or date they want after this one, in their words; empty if none.

inputVariables.name: rawWords
inputVariables.description: The caller's last words, supplied automatically.

inputVariables.name: held
inputVariables.description: The patient state held so far, supplied automatically.

inputVariables.name: acctRef
inputVariables.description: A reference to the authenticated account, supplied automatically.
